summary: Savings and investment are essential for individuals’ and families’ financial security and for long-term economic growth. Policymakers should therefore consider reforms that can help mitigate—rather than add to—tax codes’ biases against saving and investment.

title: UK Autumn Budget Prioritizes Short-Term Relief over Long-Term Growth
